title: Fiametta
description:
The project brief focused on redefining the living area and kitchen, two spaces that initially lacked cohesion and visual continuity.

The architectural strategy sought to establish a fluid and legible dialogue between these areas through a shared spatial and material language, capable of structuring the domestic environment while reinforcing the perception of a unified interior.

In support of this approach, a polished concrete floor was introduced throughout the living spaces. Its continuous surface, mineral texture, and restrained expression allow the spaces to connect seamlessly, while lending the interior a contemporary yet timeless character.

The bedroom was also carefully addressed, reconfigured to respond precisely to the client’s needs in terms of comfort, functionality, and everyday use.

Developed through close collaboration with the client, the project integrates spatial clarity, material coherence, and well-being, aligning functional requirements with a refined architectural expression.
